comment: Independent C-first human Monk. Segment 0, with DECgraphics and msg_window:full, farlooks a wall, whose putmixed() line opens with a DEC wall byte, and saves. Segment 1 restores without a symset; the saved history keeps the high byte, so the Message History window (step 2) sends it through process_text_window()'s g_putch() arm, whose recorder hook stores it one column right, where the following space overwrites it.
